answer_1.quote: We collect 7,500 interactions between 484 paid participants ... and 6 speech-in text-out systems... users receive text responses from randomly sampled systems and provide pairwise preferences.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models on benchmarks such as Librispeech and Commonvoice with metrics like word error rate (WER) and character error rate (CER). For classification tasks we report macro F1 scores and compute PEDANTS score for short text response tasks.

answer_4.quote: We collected 7,500 votes from a diverse pool of around 484 unique participants. Participants provide a pairwise preference ranking—choosing the better response or indicating no preference—and can optionally justify their choice.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to select the better response between two model outputs and optionally provide a textual justification for their choice.
